source: Spec #142 'The extraction rigs' (rig k arrives on planet 5 + 7k, in this order), #162's extractor rows (ids, names, tree nodes, the TD socket amendment's attach points) and #159's naming ruling: player text says extractor, never rig.

rigs.name: Resonance Fork
rigs.description: Tuning-fork prongs that sing a stubborn crystal soft enough to drill.

rigs.name: Containment Hood
rigs.description: A chilled hood and canister rack that bottle volatile ore before it vents.

rigs.name: Acid Etcher
rigs.description: A sprayer arm that eats glassy ore skins with patient, measured acid.

rigs.name: Induction Coil
rigs.description: A copper coil ring that pulls magnetic ore clean out of the wall.

rigs.name: Aether Tether
rigs.description: A roof reel and harpoon that keep weightless ore from drifting off.
